title: Estimation of water consumption using artificial neural network: A study on subscribers in Kocaeli Province, Turkey
content:
Abstract

This study focuses on Kocaeli province in Turkey and employs Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) to predict monthly water consumption. With approximately 800.000 water subscribers, a sample of 1.200 subscribers from residential, commercial and official categories was selected for analysis. The dataset includes water consumption records, weather information, weekends and holidays, the previous month's consumption and the influence of the COVID-19 pandemic. During an extensive 80-month period, spanning from January 2016 to August 2022, our study thoroughly analysed the dataset, ultimately achieving a notable R2 values of 0.88 for official subscribers and 0.87 for commercial subscribers, respectively. The findings of this research are highly important, considering Turkey's high water loss rate of approximately 37% (SABAH, n.d., 2022) and Turkey's per capita water supply is below the global average (“Precipitation by country, around the world”, n.d.). By leveraging artificial intelligence techniques in estimating water consumption, this study provides meaningful insights for effective water resource management and allocation.
